title: Radio: Wren 14 on Scene, Exhibit Hall B

lines.text: I'm at the Exhibit Hall B petting area with the grandparent and a festival volunteer, Marcy Delgado, who's wearing a green volunteer vest. She says she saw a man walk a little girl in a purple jacket by the hand to a dark pickup in the north lot. The truck left by the north gate, quote, around ten to two, maybe a bit before. I wasn't watching the clock. End quote.
The grandparent confirms the purple jacket. Nobody has a plate. I'm assuming command for now. I need a sergeant, and please start the entry.
Copy, Wren 14. Purple jacket, dark pickup, north lot, out the north gate around thirteen fifty, no plate. Wren 14 has command at fourteen ten. Stand by.

instructorNote: This call starts the clock on the 14:30 LEDS/NCIC deadline. COMMS should log Wren 14 as in command, send a sergeant and assign a telecommunicator to prepare the entry, then tell the IC and INV whether the account supports the Child Abduction flag. The volunteer is unsure of the time and the truck is described only as "dark," so INV should start a timeline and ask that the volunteer be kept apart for a full interview.

citations.headingPath: WCCFSP › 3. Call taking and dispatch priorities
